datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZX84C4V7 row was selected from the BZX84C2V4 through BZX84C75 electrical-characteristics table.
The Fig. 1 BZX84C4V7 trace points are digitized readings from the real plotted trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.
The BZX84C4V7 row gives VZ = 4.4 V minimum, 4.7 V nominal, and 5.0 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 80 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 500 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.

The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery specification. Fig. 5 is a series-wide typical capacitance plot without a uniquely identified BZX84C4V7 trace, so capacitance is omitted rather than assigned component-specific points.
Reverse leakage and Zener breakdown quantities retain the datasheet reverse-bias polarity: cathode positive relative to anode.
